finding: Whole-hippocampus boundary improvements coexist with delayed CA4/DG learning and subfield misclassification. Seed5 failures are predominantly CA4/DG failures on both training and validation.
leading_mechanistic_hypothesis: Early union-only bands interacts with the Dice-only base trajectory: union supervision cannot distinguish foreground subfields, and its inner-band logit gradients can reinforce an already dominant incorrect foreground class. The weak CA4/DG probability recovers late under the decaying learning rate.
limitations: Archived logit probes do not measure parameter-gradient conflict or actual Adam update direction.
The invariant and gradient probes are synthetic CPU algebra checks of frozen loss code, not replays of the failed training trajectories.
Matched fixed-FLOPs arms have a one-update and slightly different cosine-horizon difference; they are not exactly update-matched counterfactuals.
A repaired recipe has not been demonstrated. Existing completed checkpoints were already cleaned under the storage policy.

next_controlled_test.purpose: Separate timing from constraint strength while preserving the original bands definition.
timing_levels: activation near50% of the optimization budget
next_controlled_test.controls: Identical base recipe and fixed cap; fresh training-only calibration at each activation. Include schedule-matched no-bands control if isolating exact causal effect. Profile each schedule before launch.
next_controlled_test.fallback: If timing/strength cannot restore CA4/DG, test a Dice+CE base with its own unconstrained control; do not compare the changed recipe only against the old Dice-only baseline.
next_controlled_test.status: Recommendation only; no training job or live recipe modified.
